settings.question: Do I need an app or account?
settings.answer: No. There is no app, required login, or complicated setup. Tap the notification to open the daily experience in your phone’s browser.

settings.question: Does the Bible Band need a battery or charging?
settings.answer: No. The NFC chip is powered briefly by your phone when you scan it, so there is nothing to charge or replace.

settings.question: Can someone else tap my Bible Band?
settings.answer: Yes. Anyone with a compatible phone can tap your Bible Band. Use it yourself each day or share it with a friend who needs encouragement from God’s Word.

settings.question: Does my phone need internet access?
settings.answer: Yes. The band itself needs no power or connection, but your phone needs Wi-Fi or cellular data to load the daily page after the tap.

settings.question: Will my phone case block the signal?
settings.answer: Most standard cases work. Thick, metal, magnetic, battery, and wallet-style cases can interfere with NFC, so remove the case if your phone does not respond.

settings.question: Is NFC safe?
settings.answer: Yes. NFC is the same short-range technology commonly used for contactless payments. The Bible Band chip only directs your browser to a webpage; it does not access your phone or track your location.

settings.heading: How to Use Your Bible Band
settings.intro: Your daily walk with God—right on your wrist. Hold a compatible smartphone near your Bible Band and your daily Scripture experience opens automatically.
settings.support_copy: Send us a note and Pastor Clark or a Bible House Goods team member will help you get connected.
